attempted_claim: Let n>=3 with n+1<=7 and let S^{n+1} carry the round metric. Let Sigma^n subset S^{n+1} be a closed embedded minimal hypersurface obtained as a multiplicity-one Almgren-Pitts min-max limit from an (n+3)-parameter Z_2-sweepout, so that by the Marques-Neves / Li-Zhou index estimate Ind(Sigma)<=n+3. If Sigma is not totally geodesic, is Sigma necessarily congruent to a Clifford hypersurface S^k(sqrt(k/n)) x S^{n-k}(sqrt((n-k)/n)) for some 1<=k<=n-1, and hence Ind(Sigma)=n+3?
decisive_failure: The investigation is bounded by a one-hour pass and local deduction plus explicit eigenvalue computation; it does not resolve the underlying Chern-conjecture-adjacent index-to-rigidity gap for n>=3, excludes a disproof of the target (no counterexample was found or constructed), and leaves the (n+3)-width identification and any higher-dimensional Urbano-type estimate as open problems for future work.
